title: Duals of higher vector bundles and cotangents of Lie 2-groupoids
summary: In this thesis we define $n$-duals of VB $n$-groupoids over Lie $n$-groupoids and study their properties. For $n = 0$ this returns the dual vector bundle construction, while for $n = 1$ this returns Pradines's construction of the dual of a VB groupoid over a Lie groupoid, which includes the cotangent symplectic groupoid of Coste, Dazord and Weinstein. For $n = 2$, we propose a new construction that shows that VB 2-duals exist for VB 2-groupoids and they are VB 2-groupoids themselves.
